notes.title: Solitune is part of the Games Germany Steam Sale
notes.content:
Germany is celebrating some of its finest games, and we're happy to be part of it with Solitune - so check out the other games of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games_germany]Games Germany Steam Sale[/url]!
